summary: Meta's 2B-user messaging network — the contact list network effect is one of the strongest moats in technology.
moat: WhatsApp's moat is pure network effect at massive scale: with over 2 billion monthly active users, refusing to use WhatsApp in many countries means being cut off from family, friends, businesses, and civic communication. The switching cost is not the app — it is the impossibility of getting an entire social network to migrate simultaneously. End-to-end encryption and Meta's infrastructure have made it the de facto communication layer for billions.

challengers.name: Meta AI integration changing the communication dynamic
challengers.evidence: Meta is integrating Meta AI directly into WhatsApp conversations, which could alter the human-to-human communication dynamic that defines the platform's core value proposition.
